sentences.text: Hello, everyone, and welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Amelia, your host.
Today, we are going to travel to a very interesting city, Riga.
Riga is the capital of Latvia.
Latvia is a small country in Northern Europe.
It is next to Estonia and Lithuania.
Riga is a beautiful city with a lot of history, music,
and culture.
Let's explore Riga together.
Part two, where is Riga?
Riga is in the north of Europe.
It is near the Baltic Sea.
The city is close to water, so it has a big port.
The Dalgava River runs through the city.
People often take walks by the river.
You can see boats and bridges everywhere.
In winter, it can be very cold and snowy.
In summer, the weather is warm and sunny.
Part three, a short history of Riga.
Riga is an old city.
It was founded more than 800 years ago in 1201.
It started as a small trading town.
Many people came here to buy and sell goods.
Through history, Riga was ruled by different countries,
Germany, Sweden, Russia, and the Soviet Union.
After 1991, Latvia became independent again.
Today, Riga is a free and modern city.
Part four, the Old Town.
One of the most beautiful places in Riga is the Old Town.
In Latvian, it is called Vic Riga.
The Old Town has narrow streets and colorful houses.
You can see old churches and towers.
There are many cafes and small shops.
At night, the streets are full of music and light.
The architecture is amazing.
Many buildings are from the Middle Ages.
It feels like walking in history.
Part five, famous places to visit in Riga.
There are many famous places to see.
The Riga Cathedral is one of them.
It is a big church with a tall tower.
Another beautiful place is the House of the Blackheads.
It looks like a castle and is very colorful.
You can also visit Freedom Monument.
It is a tall statue that shows Latvia's freedom.
Many people go there to take photos and to think about peace.
Part six, the Art Nouveau District.
Art Nouveau is a special style of design from the early 1900s.
It has beautiful decorations, flowers and faces on the walls.
Riga has more than 800 art Nouveau buildings.
You can find them on Alberta Street and Elizabeth Street.
Walking there feels like visiting an art museum.
It is one of the most beautiful parts of the city.
Part seven, Latvian food.
Latvian food is simple but tasty.
People eat a lot of potatoes, fish and bread.
One popular dish is grey peas with bacon.
It is warm and delicious.
Another dish is rye bread.
It is dark and has a strong taste.
People in Riga also love soups, especially in winter.
For dessert, they eat honey cake or berry pie.
If you visit Riga, don't forget to try local food.
Part eight, festivals and music.
Riga loves festivals and music.
Every year, there is the Latvian Song and Dance Festival.
It is very famous.
Thousands of people sing together.
The city also has jazz and classical music concerts.
In summer, people dance outside in parks.
In winter, there are Christmas markets with lights and songs.
Music is part of life in Riga.
It connects people and makes them happy.
Part nine, nature around Riga.
Riga is close to beautiful nature.
There are forests, rivers and beaches nearby.
Jirmala is a popular seaside town close to Riga.
It has long white beaches and fresh air.
People go there to swim and relax in summer.
In the parks near the city, you can see squirrels and birds.
Nature is very important to Latvians.
They love to spend time outdoors.
Part ten, daily life in Riga.
Life in Riga is calm and friendly.
People go to work or school during the day.
Many people ride bikes or use trams.
On weekends, families go for walks or meet in cafes.
Latvian people are quiet at first, but they are kind and helpful.
In Riga, you can feel both history and modern life together.
It's a safe and clean city.
Part eleven, learning English in Riga.
Many young people in Riga speak English well.
They learn it at school from an early age.
Tourists can easily travel and communicate in English.
You can meet friendly people who want to practice with you.
If you are learning English, you can visit Riga and talk with locals.
It's a great way to improve your speaking and listening.
Part twelve, goodbye from Riga.
Our journey to Riga is coming to an end.
We learned about the old town, the history, the food, and the people.
Riga is a mix of old and new, quiet and lively.
It is a place full of charm and stories.
I hope one day you can visit Riga and see its beauty with your own eyes.
Goodbye!
